title: 第19章 夜偷灵球不忘道友第20章 登上头条震惊全宗
content_zh:
第二轮，对手是一名炼气三层巅峰的少女，虽擅长水系法术，但毫无战斗经验。
刚一开场，她挥手间便是数道凌厉水箭，直冲狐歌而去。
而狐歌依旧没有施展任何术法，只是周身泛起一层微不可察的混沌光晕。
那袭来的水箭靠近他身周三尺，便如同泥牛入海一般，被他随手拂散。
随即他身形一晃，已贴近少女身前，指尖萦绕着一丝混沌之气，悬于其咽喉之前。
少女脸色煞白，乖乖认输。
随后更戏剧的一幕来了，连着两轮他都被轮空。
这不知道是运气还是黑幕，反正他顺利的通过了海选赛，进入到了预赛。
他领完奖励之后便径直回到了玄门阁，并未理会众人嘈杂的猜测与谩骂。
“离预选赛还有半个月，看来得抓紧时间提升修为了！”
他从储物袋中拿出一枚龙眼般大小的丹药送入口中，运转功法，迅速的吸收了起来。
如今炼气三层的他吸收其丹药来也比上次快上许多。
半日时间他便将那枚丹药吸收殆尽，修为也来到了炼气三层的顶峰。
“你今日运气还真是好！”
茅不易悬于空中，发出嗡嗡的声音。
狐歌微微一笑。
“这几日我要提升修为，道兄不必守着我，等下次预选赛开赛，怕是还得靠道兄！”
“看你今日仍未用全力吧，我觉得以你的实力根本用不着我！”
“道兄高看狐某了！”
“切！”

看着眼前过分谦虚的家伙，茅不易不愿多言。
他化作一道绿光，径直钻入地底，去寻找食物去了。
道宗，男“东司”中。
“甚少，他们修炼修炼不行，拉屎也不行，算了去隔壁吧！”
茅不易震动双翼，缓缓来到隔壁，继续滚起他的灵球。
月色朦胧，夜深人静，苏皖提着灯笼，睡眼惺忪地赶往“东司”。
她白日里似乎多饮了几杯蕴含灵气的果酿，此刻腹中正翻江倒海。
“哎呀，怎么突然闹肚子了！大晚上的一个人上厕所吓死个人……”
她一边小声嘟囔着，一边“东司”的木门，寻了个隔间便解带蹲下。
就在她刚刚松了一口气时，屁股底下发出刷刷的声音。
她借着手中灯笼微弱的光线，看见了阴影之中似乎有一团……碧绿色的大虫？
content_en:
In the second round, the opponent was a girl at the third level of Qi refining. Although she was good at water spells, she had no combat experience.
As soon as she started, she waved her hand and there were several sharp water arrows, heading straight towards Hu Ge.
Hu Ge still didn't cast any spells, but there was an imperceptible halo of chaos around him.
The water arrow that came within three feet of him was scattered by him like a mud cow entering the sea.
Then he swayed and was close to the girl, with a trace of chaotic energy lingering on his fingertips, hanging in front of her throat.
The girl turned pale and surrendered obediently.
Then an even more dramatic scene came. He was given a bye in two consecutive rounds.
I don't know if it was luck or a shady secret, but he successfully passed the audition and entered the preliminaries.
After receiving the reward, he went straight back to Xuanmen Pavilion, ignoring everyone's noisy speculation and abuse.
"There's still half a month left before the qualifiers. It seems we have to seize the time to improve our cultivation!"
He took out a pill the size of a dragon's eye from his storage bag and put it into his mouth, running his technique and quickly absorbing it.
Now at the third level of Qi Refining, he can absorb the elixir much faster than last time.
In half a day, he absorbed all the elixir, and his cultivation reached the peak of the third level of Qi Refining.
"You are really lucky today!"
Mao Buyi hung in the air and made a buzzing sound.
Hu Ge smiled slightly.
"I want to improve my cultivation in the past few days. Brother Dao doesn't have to guard me. When the next qualifying competition starts, I'm afraid I will have to rely on Brother Dao!"
"Seeing as you haven't used your full strength today, I don't think you can use me at all with your strength!"
"Brother Taoist, you have high regard for Mr. Hu!"
"Cut!"
Looking at the overly modest guy in front of him, Mao Buyi didn't want to say anything.
He turned into a green light and went straight into the ground to find food.
Daozong, among the male "Dongsi".
"Very few. They can't practice cultivation and can't poop. Forget it and go next door!"
Mao Buyi fluttered his wings, slowly came to the next door, and continued to roll his spirit ball.
The moonlight was hazy and the night was quiet. Su Wan held a lantern and rushed to "Dongsi" sleepily.
She seemed to have drank a few too many glasses of fruit wine containing spiritual energy during the day, and at this moment, her stomach was turbulent.
"Oh, why did I suddenly have a stomachache? Going to the bathroom alone at night is scary to death..."
She muttered in a low voice, opened the wooden door of Dongsi, found a cubicle, took off her clothes and squatted down.
Just when she breathed a sigh of relief, there was a swishing sound from under her butt.
With the faint light of the lantern in her hand, she saw what seemed to be a group of... big green insects in the shadows?
